title: #264 The way to punish prisoners
prompt: Most countries believe that prison is the way to punish prisoners and make them better, but some people believe that education should be used to rehabilitate them. Do you agree or disagree? Support your idea with details.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Punishment acts as a strong warning, helping to keep society safe.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that alternatives to traditional punishment, such as education and community service, are more effective ways to deal with people who break the law.

angles.en: Punishment should include educational elements to help inmates improve their skills and behavior.

plans.point2: Education provides a superior, constructive path to rehabilitation by equipping individuals with marketable skills and self-sufficiency.
